_comment: Image Comparison Pipeline — DAG configuration. One Dataflow job handles all segments. Add a new segment by appending to the 'segments' array — no Java code changes needed.

pipeline._comment: All segments write to the same output tables. Use the 'segment' column to filter in BigQuery.
pipeline._comment_filter: Leave human_filter_field blank to disable payload filtering.
pipeline._comment_segments: Each segment maps a pair of method values to a segment name written into the 'segment' column of every output row. Source rows whose method does not match any entry are silently dropped. For combined segments (multiple human payloads per image), set payloadFormat='id_request' and list humanSubTypes with a discriminatorField per sub-type.

segments._comment: Combined segment: AI sends one payload; human sends two separate id_request payloads (auth + docreview) which are merged before comparison. Both sub-types share the same humanMethod.
segments.name: authanddocreview
